ValidationRule.description: SF-1100 Scenario 2 / SF-1237 — require Draft Contract Link for Expansion + New Product when moving Due Diligence to Contracting (c2c fix)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Expansion"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Product"), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Due Diligence"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contracting"), ISBLANK(Draft_Contract_Link__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add Draft Contract Link before moving to Contracting.
